optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        sum(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN date_dim
        ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address
        ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_salutation,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_day,
    c_birth_month,
    c_birth_year,
    c_birth_country,
    c_login,
    c_email_address,
    c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
) AS ctr2
    ON ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
JOIN customer
    ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address
    ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr2.ctr_total_return
  AND ca_state = 'AR'
ORDER BY
    c_customer_id,
    c_salutation,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_day,
    c_birth_month,
    c_birth_year,
    c_birth_country,
    c_login,
    c_email_address,
    c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
